name: aura-audit
description: Autonomous Engineering Audit Engine — continuous audit-remediate-verify loop that drives repositories toward a defensible production-grade state through full-spectrum audit cycles with strict state machine enforcement
author: AURA Engineering <engineering@aura-audit.dev>

scripts.postinstall: node -e "var fs=require('fs'),p=require('path'),r=__dirname,t=p.join(r,'.aura'),c=p.join(r,'.githooks'),e=process.cwd();try{if(!fs.existsSync(p.join(e,'.aura'))){fs.cpSync(t,p.join(e,'.aura'),{recursive:true});console.log('[aura] .aura/ bootstrap copied to project')}}catch(err){console.error('[aura] Could not copy .aura/ bootstrap:',err.message)}try{var h=p.join(e,'.githooks');if(!fs.existsSync(h)){fs.cpSync(c,h,{recursive:true});console.log('[aura] .githooks/ copied to project')}}catch(err){console.error('[aura] Could not copy .githooks/:',err.message)}"
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:python
